prompt: A junior teammate just opened a PR adding the first Playwright end-to-end spec for the login-to-orders flow, and asked you — a mid-level engineer — to review it before merge. The file below has three `test(...)` cases, each logging in and then asserting something about the orders list. Walk through the review as a senior teammate would: identify the maintainability and flakiness problems, rank them by impact, and for each one prescribe the resilient pattern (selector strategy, deduplication, deterministic waiting/assertions) — explaining the mechanism behind the rule, not just naming the smell.
